data.exact_reserve_text: During the year there was an overall negative net run-off development of GBP 23,233,000 (2013 GBP 17,262,000 positive) of which the major contributor was third party liability of GBP 20,420,000 adverse (2013 GBP 13,006,000 positive) together with a negative development in reinsurance acceptances of GBP  2,813,000 (2013 GBP 4,256,000 positive).
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate opened 2014 with gross claims outstanding of GBP 1,227.401m. During 2014 there was adverse prior year development (net of reinsurance) of GBP 23.233m, representing a strengthening of reserves of approximately 1.9% of opening gross claims outstanding. The deterioration was driven mainly by third party liability (general liability) and by reinsurance acceptances, with professional indemnity/general liability classes highlighted as worse than expected.
raw_causal_phrases: overall negative net run-off development of GBP 23,233,000
major contributor was third party liability of GBP 20,420,000 adverse
negative development in reinsurance acceptances of GBP  2,813,000
worse than expected experience from the general liability and professional indemnity classes
data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Balance Sheet prior-year comparative (explicit). Prior year development figure used is explicit in the notes but quoted as 'net run-off development' (net of reinsurance). No explicit GROSS prior-year movement (insurance liabilities) was found in the available notes or a gross claims movement table; therefore the prior year development amount returned is NET of reinsurance. Percentage calculated against opening gross claims outstanding. No claims development triangle was located.
